title: Excellent customer support
body: Great customer support from Nick and the Ultiself team. They resolved my issue quickly, kept me updated throughout the process, and genuinely cared about finding the right solution. It’s refreshing to see a company that listens to feedback and takes action. Thanks again for the help! 😊
author: viktorijaMar

title: Might be something i'd use forever
body: An app that can help be with my habits like excessive eating or procrastination is quite frankly the best choice for me right now. I've been feeling burnt out for a few month now, not knowing where to start, this app might change that. Although its a bit pricy, the UI is clean and understandable, the app seems well made, the good habits it recommends are simple to follow and personally made for you, like get a full 8 hours of sleep? Sure, I'll do it, its something i can do! In all seriousness, this might help me be myself again, you get a free 7 day trail , give it a go, it costs you nothing. (literally)
